assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: high-detail game-world quarry landmark sprite, derived faithfully from the project's OWN original illustration.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact visual authority, not loose inspiration. Preserve its original quarry rather than designing a new quarry.
Primary request: isolate the complete connected PALE GRANITE QUARRY as a genuinely transparent RGBA world asset. Keep the exact same fixed orthographic camera, composition, silhouette, stepped layout, chunky hand-painted volume, lighting, palette and fine detail of the supplied image. The large high left/rear rock massif, all the angular cut stone faces, dark narrow cracks, broad descending worked terraces, loose blocks, chips, grassy ledges and contact shadows must remain as shown. Do not replace any of this with a smooth mound or scattered stones. Preserve the sharp layered stone architecture and the painted surface texture at full detail.
Change only these things: (1) remove the roofed quarry workshop at lower left and the wooden crane/derrick on the right, since those will become separate constructible building assets later; fill their vacated spots with matching bare quarry ground, keeping a clear usable construction pad where the workshop was; no new building, foundations, marker or symbol. (2) remove the distant uniform green backdrop outside the irregular connected quarry/foreground work-pad footprint, making that area truly transparent. Keep the quarry's own close grass tufts, small bushes, loose rocks, local earth, and soft contact shadows attached to its silhouette; transition the outer local ground edge cleanly into alpha with no rectangular ground plate or black/white halo. Remove remote standalone background trees that are not part of this quarry footprint.
Invariants: no restyling, no camera change, no rearranging or smoothing the rock mass, no reduced detail, no different colors, no extra architecture, no labels/UI/text/watermark. Keep the full connected landmark in frame at approximately the original scale with transparent margins. Preserve reference appearance as closely as possible. Output one coherent detailed quarry cutout, not a sheet or collage.
assets.rights: Original project-generated source and derived artwork; no third-party inputs

Keep the exact original camera/viewpoint, silhouette, the rich overlapping groups of mature firs, their full painted volume/needled branches/brown trunks, small young trees, saplings and stumps, rock accents, forest floor details and dappled soft contact shadows.
